name: tictacthetoe
subTitle: Personal Project with Nuxt
description: This is the second rendition of my university project ultimateTicTacToe. I wanted to do it with Nuxt3. The game is hosted on vercel.

name: Lego-Robo in a Labyrinth
subTitle: University Project using Kotlin, OSC, and Python
description: Developed in a team of three during the fifth semester as part of the 'Robotics' module. A 'Lego robot' was programmed to autonomously navigate through a maze while mapping it. After completing the mapping process, it determined and followed the shortest path to three differently colored fields using A*.

name: Robot for a Museum
subTitle: University Project using Kotlin
description: A team of three developed this project during the fifth semester as part of the 'Robotics' module. A 'Temi' robot was programmed to autonomously guide visitors through the computer museum, enhancing the interactive experience.

name: Lighthouse
subTitle: University Project using Java, Nuxt, OSC, and Docker
description: Developed in a team of five during the fifth semester as part of the 'Software Engineering' module. The project involved bringing the game 'Tetris' to life by displaying and playing it on the facade of the University high-rise.

name: Human Benchmark
subTitle: University Project using C++ and Scrum
description: Developed as part of a fourth-semester university project in the modules ‘Agile Development Methods’ and ‘Programming with C++’. The application is a collection of small games designed to test various human abilities. The project was completed in a team of 11, following Scrum methodology. My responsibilities included acting as the product owner while also contributing to the development process.

name: Army of Frogs
subTitle: University Project using Java and Cucumber
description: A fourth-semester university project in the ‘Testing in Software’ module, developed in a team of three. The goal was to implement the game ‘Army of Frogs’ using Java and Behavior-Driven Development (BDD).

name: Job Swiper
subTitle: University Project using Flutter
description: A third-semester university project in the ‘Mobile Systems’ module, developed in a team of two. The application integrates the API of the Federal Employment Agency in Germany, allowing users to swipe through job vacancies in a style similar to ‘Tinder’.

name: KI Agent: Boffin
subTitle: University Project using Java
description: Developed in the third semester as part of the ‘Introduction to AI’ module in a two-person team. The project focused on creating an AI agent capable of playing ‘Cathedral’ against another AI opponent.

name: ultimateTicTacToe
subTitle: University Project with vanilla JS, HTML, and CSS
description: A second-semester project in the ‘Web Applications’ module. This implementation of tic-tac-toe introduces an additional layer of complexity, where each square contains a smaller tic-tac-toe board. The mark on a small board determines the the next larger board, adding a strategic element to the game. The win of a small board determines the mark on the larger board.

name: WA-FeWo
subTitle: University Project with vanilla JS, HTML, and CSS
description: A second-semester project in the ‘Web Applications’ module, focusing on the development of a booking platform for holiday flats. The application processes data from an Airbnb CSV file to display available rentals.
